$Comment: Beat the Great Turkey in the Turkey Graveyard several times, over as many feasts as it takes.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names the fight's encounter script, as Great_Turkey_Down.json does, with MatchMode
PREFIX, so a win on the hard way in (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter_Hard) counts too, and every
player the fight credits counts the win. Amount is sized to the feast's two and a half weeks: a player
who goes in most days reaches it in their first feast. The description's number comes from the
criterion's Amount through @amount, and the criterion's TextKey words the step.
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and wins add up from one feast to the next. It
carries no full_table tag, so The Full Table never waits on it. The chain
kills_harvest_feast_great_turkey makes it the first rung of a ladder in the book, under Great Turkey
Slayer (Great_Turkey_Slayer.json). It pays Harvest Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Defense XP
for the fights, waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and
unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_great_turkey_hunter, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
